title: Rust off Rails: The opinionated web stack for the AI era
title_zh: Rust off Rails：面向 AI 时代的独断式 Web 技术栈

paragraphs.en: Rails' conventions, without Rails. Your agent writes the code, and the checks keep it on the tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 没有 Rails，也有 Rails 的约定。 你的智能体负责写代码，而各种检查让它始终保持在轨道上。

sents.en: Rails' conventions, without Rails.
sents.zh: 没有 Rails，也有 Rails 的约定。

sents.en: Your agent writes the code, and the checks keep it on the tracks.
sents.zh: 你的智能体负责写代码，而各种检查让它始终保持在轨道上。

paragraphs.en: You describe a web app in plain words. Your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Muse or any other) builds it in Rust from our conventions, a tested app template and optional parts, and it isn't done until the tests pass on SQLite and Postgres. The convention lives in the prose. The agent writes the code.
paragraphs.zh: 你用平实的语言描述一个 Web 应用。 你的编码智能体（Claude Code、Codex、opencode、Muse 或其他任何智能体）会依据我们的约定、一个经过测试的应用模板和可选组件，用 Rust 构建它，而且只有在测试在 SQLite 和 Postgres 上都通过后才算完成。 约定存在于文字描述之中。 智能体负责编写代码。

paragraphs.en: Four things your coding agent uses to build a full-stack Rust web app. All of it is copied into your app, so it's yours to read and change.
paragraphs.zh: 你的编码智能体用来构建全栈 Rust Web 应用的四样东西。 所有内容都会复制到你的应用中，因此你可以随意阅读和修改。

paragraphs.en: AGENTS.md and the guides tell the agent how to do each thing: the stack, the layout, naming, security and tests. Your agent reads them, so you don't have to. Browse the guides .
paragraphs.zh: AGENTS.md 和各指南告诉智能体如何做每件事：技术栈、布局、命名、安全和测试。 你的智能体会阅读它们，所以你不必这样做。请浏览这些指南。

paragraphs.en: A complete app that compiles and passes its tests on SQLite and Postgres on day one: sessions, security headers, CSRF, Docker and CI. The template .

paragraphs.en: Mail and a dev mailbox, a job queue and its dashboard, sign-in, realtime and a dev dashboard: tested code to copy, one command each. Read them first in the samples repo or on the parts page .
paragraphs.zh: 邮件功能和一个开发邮箱、一个任务队列及其仪表盘、登录、实时功能和开发仪表盘：每个都附有可复制、经测试的代码，各只需一条命令。 请先在示例仓库或组件页面中阅读它们。

paragraphs.en: offrails-check and one command, cargo offrails verify , decide when the agent is done: tests on both databases, every acceptance criterion tested. The checks .

paragraphs.en: The rule behind it: all code is written by AI. You say what you want, in plain words or in specs; the agent writes the rest. Read §0 .

paragraphs.en: Fizzy's boards and cards, rebuilt in Rust by agents.

paragraphs.en: 1,556 tests green on SQLite and Postgres.

paragraphs.en: These are optional parts, and we highly recommend them: traces, a profiler, a local mailbox, a jobs dashboard and live presence. With them you see what your app is doing from the first run, and your agent reads the same data as JSON, so it can check its own work. Take the ones you want, skip the rest.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是可选组件，我们强烈推荐使用：追踪、性能分析器、本地邮箱、任务面板以及实时在线状态。 有了它们，你的应用从第一次运行起你就能看到它在做什么，而且你的智能体也能以 JSON 形式读取相同的数据，从而检查自己的工作。 想要哪个就用哪个，其余的可以跳过。

paragraphs.en: The dashboard costs about 1 µs per request in a release build, and is development only by default.
paragraphs.zh: 该仪表板在 release 构建中每个请求的开销约为 1 µs，且默认仅在开发环境下启用。

paragraphs.en: Markdown carries the conventions. A checker, offrails-check , runs on every app, this site included, and says no when an agent breaks one. The rules come from mistakes agents actually made.
paragraphs.zh: Markdown 承载这些约定。 一个名为 offrails-check 的检查器会在每个应用上运行，包括本网站，当智能体违反其中一条时会予以拒绝。 这些规则来自智能体实际犯过的错误。

paragraphs.en: Then the test suites must pass on both databases before anything counts as done. The Definition of Done →
paragraphs.zh: 那么测试套件必须在两个数据库上都通过，之后才算完成。「完成定义」（Definition of Done）→

paragraphs.en: An agent isn't done until one command, cargo offrails verify --full , passes: the tests on SQLite and Postgres, every acceptance criterion cited by a test, at least 80% line coverage (90% for models and policies), no unwrap outside startup, migrations that roll back, dependency and secret scans, no accessibility violations in light or dark, and a screenshot of every page. The rules come from years of shipping and upgrading apps on other stacks.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体在一条命令 cargo offrails verify --full 通过之前不算完成：该命令要检查 SQLite 和 Postgres 上的测试、每条被测试引用的验收标准、至少 80% 的行覆盖率（模型和策略为 90%）、启动代码之外没有 unwrap、可回滚的迁移、依赖和密钥扫描、浅色和深色模式下无无障碍违规，以及每个页面的截图。 这些规则来自多年在其他技术栈上交付和升级应用的经验。

sents.en: An agent isn't done until one command, cargo offrails verify --full , passes: the tests on SQLite and Postgres, every acceptance criterion cited by a test, at least 80% line coverage (90% for models and policies), no unwrap outside startup, migrations that roll back, dependency and secret scans, no accessibility violations in light or dark, and a screenshot of every page.
sents.zh: 一个智能体在一条命令 cargo offrails verify --full 通过之前不算完成：该命令要检查 SQLite 和 Postgres 上的测试、每条被测试引用的验收标准、至少 80% 的行覆盖率（模型和策略为 90%）、启动代码之外没有 unwrap、可回滚的迁移、依赖和密钥扫描、浅色和深色模式下无无障碍违规，以及每个页面的截图。

sents.en: The rules come from years of shipping and upgrading apps on other stacks.
sents.zh: 这些规则来自多年在其他技术栈上交付和升级应用的经验。

paragraphs.en: Measured by the agents that ran them. How upgrades work →
paragraphs.zh: 由运行它们的智能体来衡量。升级如何运作 →

paragraphs.en: Every app starts with the same protections and the same accessibility checks, and its tests prove them.
paragraphs.zh: 每个应用都从相同的保护和相同的无障碍检查开始，并且其测试证明了这一点。

paragraphs.en: The agent asks only what a human can answer, writes the answers down, and is done only when the compiler and the test suite on both databases agree.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体只问人类能够回答的问题，将答案记录下来，只有当两个数据库上的编译器和测试套件都一致时才算完成。

paragraphs.en: The boxes show an example app, a bookshelf, in the formats the framework really uses.
paragraphs.zh: 这些框图展示了一个示例应用——一个书架——以框架实际使用的格式呈现。

paragraphs.en: Product questions only, each with a recommended default. "Who can see this?" yes; "which ORM?" never. Say "you decide" and it takes the defaults.
paragraphs.zh: 只问产品相关的问题，每个问题都附有一个推荐的默认选项。 「谁能看到这个？」要问；「用哪个 ORM？」永远别问。 你说一句「你来决定」，它就会采用默认选项。

paragraphs.en: Red at any station? The failure goes back to the agent, and nothing counts as done until it is green on both databases.
paragraphs.zh: 任意站点都显示红色吗？ 故障会返回给智能体，在两个数据库都变绿之前，任何事都不算完成。

sents.en: Red at any station?

sents.en: The failure goes back to the agent, and nothing counts as done until it is green on both databases.
sents.zh: 故障会返回给智能体，在两个数据库都变绿之前，任何事都不算完成。

paragraphs.en: Say what you want , or write it in product/features/*.md . Plain English.
paragraphs.zh: 随便你怎么说，或者写在 product/features/*.md 里。用大白话就行。

paragraphs.en: The agent writes the spec, then the code: migrations, models, views, tests.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体先编写规格说明，然后编写代码：数据库迁移、模型、视图、测试。

paragraphs.en: Done means green on SQLite and Postgres, every acceptance criterion tested.
paragraphs.zh: 完成的标准是 SQLite 和 Postgres 上的测试全部通过，且每一条验收标准都已测试。

paragraphs.en: Axum · Tokio · SeaORM SQLite locally, Postgres in production, same code · Askama · Tailwind · lettre · tracing · one binary, one Docker image
paragraphs.zh: Axum · Tokio · SeaORM 本地使用 SQLite，生产环境使用 Postgres，同一套代码 · Askama · Tailwind · lettre · tracing · 一个二进制文件，一个 Docker 镜像

paragraphs.en: Askama templates, checked at compile time, plus htmx. No Node. For CRUD apps, dashboards, content sites (like this one).
paragraphs.zh: Askama 模板在编译期检查，配合 htmx 使用。不需要 Node。 适用于 CRUD 应用、仪表盘和内容网站（比如本站）。

paragraphs.en: React or Svelte pages with server-side routing and controllers, through a generated Inertia adapter. The pick when you want a JS UI.
paragraphs.zh: 通过生成的 Inertia 适配器，实现带有服务端路由和控制器的 React 或 Svelte 页面。 当你想要一个 JS 界面时的选择。

paragraphs.en: A separate single-page app plus a JSON API, for when the UI must be a standalone app. Types flow from Rust via ts-rs .
paragraphs.zh: 一个独立的单页应用加上一个 JSON API，适用于 UI 必须是独立应用的情况。 类型通过 ts-rs 从 Rust 传递过来。

paragraphs.en: No UI at all: a backend and a versioned API for mobile apps, partners and scripts.
paragraphs.zh: 完全没有用户界面：一个后端以及面向移动应用、合作伙伴和脚本的带版本控制的 API。

paragraphs.en: And in the database: a job queue, a cache and pub/sub. The database is the only infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 数据库方面还包括：一个任务队列、一个缓存以及发布/订阅。 数据库是唯一的基础设施。

paragraphs.en: None of the good ideas here are new. We took the ones that aged best from two frameworks we love, gave each a Rust shape, and wrote them down for agents.
paragraphs.zh: 这里所有好的想法都不是新的。 我们从两个我们喜爱的框架中选取了经受住时间考验的那些想法，为每个想法赋予了 Rust 的形态，并将它们记录下来供智能体使用。

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add rust-off-rails/rustoffrails /plugin install offrails@offrails Then, in an empty directory:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add rust-off-rails/rustoffrails /plugin install offrails@offrails 然后，在一个空目录中：

paragraphs.en: /offrails:new bookshelf: people track the books they've read and review them The agent interviews you, confirms a plan, then builds. Skills also trigger on plain requests ("make me a new Rust web app…").
paragraphs.zh: /offrails:new 书架：人们记录自己读过的书并进行评价。智能体会先采访你，确认一个计划，然后进行构建。 技能也可以由普通请求触发（“帮我做一个新的 Rust Web 应用……”）。

paragraphs.en: Read /path/to/rustoffrails/AGENTS.md and make me a new app called "bookshelf". Generated apps carry AGENTS.md and a vendored .offrails/ , so later sessions need no setup.
paragraphs.zh: 读取 /path/to/rustoffrails/AGENTS.md，并为我创建一个名为“bookshelf”的新应用。 生成的应用会附带 AGENTS.md 和内置的 .offrails/ 目录，因此后续会话无需任何设置。
